subject: Coverage scope and endorsement request for QuantaCloud onboarding
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@quantacloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage scope and endorsement request for QuantaCloud onboarding

Hi Samir —

Thanks for moving quickly on the onboarding paperwork. To keep the activation moving we need a few clarifications on the certificate of insurance (COI) and any endorsements: 

- Commercial general liability: evidence of $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate.
- Professional / tech liability (E&O / Cyber): $2,000,000 limit recommended given the data processing scope.
- Redwood Inference (Redwood Inference, Inc.) listed as Additional Insured on the GL policy, with a Primary and Non-Contributory endorsement.
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood for GL and WC where permitted by law.
- If QuantaCloud uses subcontractors who will access or process Redwood data, please provide a subcontractor list (name, scope, country) and confirm they carry equivalent cyber coverage.

For reference, I attached our vendor intake form (vendor_intake_form.xlsx) — populate sections A–C and return. Once the certificates + endorsements meet the criteria, procurement will issue a conditional PO within 3 business days and route for billing setup. If a standard endorsement form is required from your broker we can accept the ISO wording or a carrier letter that explicitly mirrors the items above.

Quick asks: can you send the current COI and any endorsements today? If your broker needs Redwood’s full legal name or address, use: 

  Redwood Inference, Inc.
  500 Market St, Suite 230
  San Francisco, CA 94105

Thanks — cc'ing Ben for billing and Irene for legal intake.

Cheers,
Priyom
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_intake_form.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Samir Rao <samir@quantacloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@quantacloud.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage scope and endorsement request for QuantaCloud onboarding

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the checklist. I attached our current COI and the W9, plus our current subcontractor roster. A couple of quick clarifying questions from our broker / contracts team:

- Our GL carrier is willing to add Redwood as Additional Insured but needs to confirm whether Redwood requires policy language 'Primary and Non-Contributory' or if 'Primary' is sufficient for your internal controls.
- For cyber/tech E&O, we have a separate policy with $2M aggregate — do you require an endorsement naming Redwood, or is the COI line sufficient?
- For subcontractors, our current partners include one EU-based hosting subprocessor; do you have any extra requirements for EU-hosted subprocessors beyond equivalent cyber limits?

We pushed: COI_QuantaCloud.pdf, W9_QuantaCloud.pdf, subcontractor_list.csv. If you can confirm exact endorsement language or an example endorsement PDF, we'll route through the broker and share the updated COI.

Best,
Samir Rao
Head of Finance & Ops
QuantaCloud Inc.

Attachments: COI_QuantaCloud.pdf, W9_QuantaCloud.pdf, subcontractor_list.csv

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@quantacloud.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage scope and endorsement request for QuantaCloud onboarding

Thanks Samir — this is helpful. A few clarifications from Redwood's side to help your broker: 

1) Endorsement language we need (preferred):
- Additional Insured endorsement confirming Redwood Inference, Inc. is an Additional Insured for ongoing operations and products/completed operations. Policy should read Primary and Non-Contributory.
- Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc.

2) Cyber / E&O: an endorsement naming Redwood is preferred but if the policy is written to include third-party customers on the COI line with limits clearly shown, that is acceptable as long as the carrier confirms coverage applies to subcontractor activity.

3) Subcontractors: the CSV you sent is fine for now. Please flag any subprocessor that will store unredacted Redwood customer data or have admin-level access; for those, we require either equivalent cyber coverage or written agreement that QuantaCloud will flow down the same protections.

Next steps / timeline:
- If you can get the broker to upload an updated COI + endorsement (sample_endorsement.pdf attached as an example) by EOD Monday (5/31), procurement will accept and open a conditional PO by Tues 6/1, and billing will start the vendor setup.
- If your carrier cannot provide Primary and Non-Contributory wording, let us know and we'll route for an exception request (this can add 5–7 business days).

Ben — can you confirm if we need any additional tax step once W9 is received?

Thanks,
Priyom

Attachment: sample_endorsement.pdf

From: Samir Rao <samir@quantacloud.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@quantacloud.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage scope and endorsement request for QuantaCloud onboarding

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear guidance and the example endorsement. Our broker confirmed they can issue an Additional Insured endorsement with Primary and Non-Contributory language and will add the waiver of subrogation. They expect to upload the revised COI and endorsement to the shared portal by EOD today.

We attached the preliminary COI with an indicator that the endorsement is pending. Once the broker finalizes and we have the signed endorsement, we will forward the carrier-signed COI_with_endorsement.pdf.

We aim to have everything completed to meet your timeline and appreciate the clear acceptance criteria. Please confirm whether the conditional PO will be visible in the vendor portal or sent by email.

Best regards,
Samir

Attachments: COI_with_endorsement.pdf
